name: bible-verse-statusbar
description: Shows a random Bible verse in the VS Code status bar and which changes over time.

commands.title: Bible Verse: Store YouVersion App Key
Bible Verse: Clear YouVersion App Key

bibleVerse.showBibleVersionInTooltip.description: Show the Bible version abbreviation in parentheses in the status bar hover tooltip.

bibleVerse.shrinkToFit.description: Use only the space needed by the verse when it is shorter than the configured status bar width.

bibleVerse.statusBarWidth.description: Approximate width reserved for the status bar item.

bibleVerse.displayFullVerse.description: Display the full verse text in the status bar. Turn this off to show just the verse reference (for example: Hebrews 2:4).

bibleVerse.bibleId.markdownDescription: The YouVersion Bible ID to request passages from, for example `3034` for the Berean Standard Bible. [Browse available Bible versions](https://www.bible.com/languages/eng). If this ID is invalid or unavailable, the extension tries Bible ID `3034` (Berean Standard Bible).

bibleVerse.randomOrSequential.description: Display a random verse or advance to the next verse in sequence.

bibleVerse.refreshFrequency.description: Minutes between automatic verse refreshes. Used only when Refresh Mode is set to Schedule.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Refresh the verse when VS Code opens, with no automatic updates while it remains open.
Refresh the verse periodically using the Refresh Frequency setting.
bibleVerse.refreshMode.description: Choose whether verses refresh only when VS Code opens or periodically.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show the current verse in a notification.
Replace the current verse with a new random verse when clicked.
bibleVerse.clickAction.markdownDescription: Choose what happens when the status bar item is clicked.
